breeding.title: Breeding Calculator
breeding.metaTitle: Palworld Breeding Calculator – All Combos & Path Finder
breeding.metaDescription: Every Palworld breeding combo for the current game version: pick two parents to see the child, find every parent pair for any Pal, or plan the fastest breeding path from the Pals you own.
breeding.intro: Pick two parents to see their child, look up every parent pair for a Pal, or let the path finder plan the fewest eggs from the Pals you own. Calculated from the game files of the current version.
breeding.why.same: Two Pals of the same species always hatch that species.
breeding.why.unique: Special combination: this pair always hatches this Pal.
breeding.why.rank: Breeding power {{a}} + {{b}} → {{target}}. The child is the Pal with the closest breeding power ({{child}}).
breeding.pairs.none: This Pal cannot be bred — catch it in the wild.
breeding.owned.hint: Add the Pals you have (both genders are assumed). Saved in this browser.
breeding.path.none: Not reachable from your Pals. Add more Pals, or catch one of the parents below.
breeding.path.needOwned: Add the Pals you own to plan a path.
breeding.path.note: Eggs are an estimate: a hatched Pal has a random gender, so steps that need a specific gender may take a few tries.
breeding.palMetaTitle: How to Breed {{name}} in Palworld – All Breeding Combos
breeding.palMetaDescription: All {{count}} parent combinations that hatch {{name}} in Palworld, from the current game files, plus what {{name}} breeds with others.
breeding.palIntro: {{name}} has breeding power {{rank}}. Below are all parent pairs that hatch it.
breeding.palIntroUnique: {{name}} can only be bred through its special combination.
